# 0.4.0 — First-user fixes

22 September 2026. Minor on the public **0.3.0** beta.

Fixes the first-user bugs filed against 0.3.0 and the CI harness gaps that let them ship. Several fixes change output that scripts can depend on — read **Changed** before upgrading a pipeline. If you generated GitHub CI with `opentide setup ci`, regenerate it — see **Security**.

## Install

```bash
pip install opentide==0.4.0
export OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT=/path/to/detection-repo
opentide validate --strict
```

Regenerate generated CI and hooks to pick up the fixed templates:

```bash
opentide setup ci <github|gitlab|azure> --yes
opentide setup hooks --yes
```

## Security

- The inflight job from `opentide setup ci github` pushed the pull request head to the default branch, so an up-to-date pull request landed there unreviewed. Inflight jobs on every CI now commit only `.opentide/inflight/` shards, from a worktree of the default branch. Regenerate with `opentide setup ci <github|gitlab|azure> --yes` ([#244](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/244)).

## Changed

- `opentide validate query` is an offline syntax check (KQL, SPL, S1QL, Lucene) by default and needs no SDK, credentials, or network. The tenant round-trip is `validate query --live` ([#239](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/239)).
- `validate query` for CrowdStrike and HarfangLab returns the normal `ok` / `status` envelope with `supported: false` ([#247](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/247)).
- `query` is required and non-blank on Splunk and Carbon Black configurations ([#233](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/233)).
- `opentide --json setup` without `--yes` exits with one JSON error instead of starting the wizard ([#255](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/255)).
- MCP `search` always returns a list; `platform=` matches the configuration key exactly; `coverage` for a parent technique includes sub-technique rules and reports `matched_techniques` ([#252](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/252), [#253](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/253)).
- MCP `opentide://vocabularies` is an index (`metadata`, `entry_count`, `uri`); entries live at `opentide://vocabularies/{name}` ([#254](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/254)).
- MCP `run_query` is an explicit stub (`stub: true`, `rows: null`) ([#258](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/258)).
- `mcp` is pinned `<2`; the unused `fastmcp` dependency is gone; `opentide[sentinel]` declares the Azure packages it imports ([#256](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/256)).
- Positional `PATH` on `setup` subcommands is deprecated in favour of `--path` / `-C` ([#248](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/248)).

## Fixed

- `deploy metadata` and `generate inflight prune` no longer run their parent command first ([#243](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/243)).
- `opentide info coverage --technique T1059` parses in either order ([#257](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/257)).
- Every `setup` subcommand accepts `--path` / `-C` and `--yes` / `-y`, also when given before the subcommand; other `setup` options there are refused rather than ignored ([#248](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/248)).
- `validate --file objects/rules/x.yaml` honours the directory ([#240](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/240)).
- Unparseable object YAML is a `yaml_parse` validation issue, not a traceback ([#250](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/250)).
- `generate docs --changed` / `generate inflight` handle repositories without commits, non-`main` trunks, untracked rules, non-ASCII file names, pushed feature branches, and workspaces nested inside the checkout ([#241](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/241), [#251](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/251)).
- `generate extract sentinel|defender` report the missing extra, tenant, or key instead of failing at import ([#242](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/242)).
- `opentide generate explorer` is registered; the GitHub CI template calls it instead of `opentide explorer build` ([#202](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/202)).
- Sentinel-only runs load only the Sentinel engine ([#246](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/246)).
- GitLab inflight jobs use `${CI_JOB_TOKEN}`; Azure inflight jobs actually commit and push ([#244](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/244)).
- The pre-commit hook validates the commit's worktree, not an exported `OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT`; it covers nested and multiple workspaces and fails when its workspace is gone ([#249](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/249)).
- `--no-color`, `NO_COLOR`, and `FORCE_COLOR=0` strip every ANSI escape, Typer help and usage errors included ([#282](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/pull/282)).
- MCP reads `rule.techniques` / `threat.actors` and filters UUID searches ([#252](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/252)), resolves `opentide://schemas/rule` and versioned template IDs ([#254](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/254)), and `validate_query` reports real findings ([#245](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/245)).
- `opentide-mcp` without the `mcp` extra prints the install line instead of a traceback ([#256](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/256)).
- `splunk::2.x` rules validate and deploy with the same field mapping, and a migrated `cron_schedule` is scheduled ([#233](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/233)).
- Tutorial and CLI reference samples match live output ([#247](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/247)).

## Tests

CI now runs the first-user paths these bugs lived on ([#259](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/259)): real-PTY setup ([#260](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/260)), real query validators ([#261](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/261)), `opentide-mcp` from the wheel ([#262](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/262)), an argv matrix ([#263](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/263)), unmocked MCP over stdio ([#264](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/264)), hooks that `git commit` ([#265](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/265)), unmocked extract/explorer ([#266](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/266)), repo-relative `--file` ([#267](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/267)), git baselines ([#268](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/268)), GitLab/Azure job scripts ([#269](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/269)), and every documented command checked against the CLI ([#270](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/270)).

Not in this release: [#189](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/189), which waits on [OpenTideHQ/specifications#12](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/specifications/issues/12).

## Verify

```bash
python -c "import opentide; print(opentide.__version__)"
opentide setup --yes --name "Tutorial Detections" --org "Example Corp" --platform sentinel --path /tmp/tutorial-detections
opentide --repo /tmp/tutorial-detections generate
opentide --repo /tmp/tutorial-detections validate --strict
opentide --json --repo /tmp/tutorial-detections validate query --platform sentinel
```

Expect `0.4.0`. `validate query` must succeed with `mode: offline-syntax` on a plain `pip install opentide` (no Azure SDK).
